title: Wooden Tools Variety
description: Adds different types of wooden tools based on type of planks, Even modded ones.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7796796ca4de159f36377f838cf7bad15c458917.png)
## About
**Wooden Tools Variety** is a mod that completely changes the vanilla wooden tools recipes entirely so it'll make them based on the planks used. Each wood types has **different Efficiency and Durability** (well some of them are just same as vanilla one).

It also has compability with some mods makes it adds new wood type of tools.

(Currently it's only [BiomesOPlenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty))

## Compatibility
### Fully Compatible
Mods that makes it adds new wood type of tools

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- BiomesOPlenty

</details>

### Compatible Crafting
Mods that makes other modded planks still craftable as vanilla one. If there isnt a mod in here you're looking for, It might be **incompatible**. I'd recommend check below for more info.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- BetterNether
- BetterEnd
- Blooming Nature (Let's Do)
- Meadow (Let's Do)
- Nature Spririt
- Traverse
- Vinery (Let's Do)
- Beach Party (Let's Do)
- Biomes We've Gone
- Terrestria
- Regions Unexplored
- Twilight Forest

</details>

### Help I can't craft with other modded planks!1!
I'd recommend use [CraftTweaker](https://modrinth.com/mod/crafttweaker) or [KubeJS](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) for this. You can also download the scripts for setup here:
**CraftTweaker**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Download the scripts [here](https://github.com/ExperionPlanet/WoodenToolsVariety/blob/1.21.1/recipe_scripts/woodentoolsvariant_crafttweaker.zs) (from my github)
and put it right there:

```
minecraft/scripts
```

</details>

**KubeJS**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Download the scripts [here](https://github.com/ExperionPlanet/WoodenToolsVariety/blob/1.21.1/recipe_scripts/woodentoolsvariety_kubejs.js) (from my github)
and put it right there:

```
minecraft/kubejs/server_scripts
```

</details>
